title: Think aloud, then show, then check
statement: When modelling, say what you will do, show it done, then check, putting nothing on screen before it is thought aloud and keeping one target of attention at a time.
detail: Review feedback on one lesson asked for a set choreography for modelling: say what will be done, let it be seen done, then the check, with nothing on screen before it is thought aloud, feedback finished before the next step renders, one target of attention at a time and only the current sentence highlighted. An earlier review found the steps and the question being answered scrolling away during modelling, so the student lost the thread, and asked for both to stay visible with one thing surfacing at a time.
